-- clean --
set shell := ["bash", "-cu"]
version := "1"
export TOKEN := "x"

# Build it
build target="debug": (compile target)
    echo {{version}} $TOKEN

compile profile:
    echo {{profile}}
-- unterminated-string --
x := "abc
a:
    echo
-- invalid-escape --
x := "\q"
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- missing-colon --
a b c
    echo
-- unexpected-indent --
a:
    echo

  stray
-- unknown-dependency --
a: nope
    echo
-- unknown-qualified-dependency --
a: foo::b
    echo
-- unknown-variable --
a:
    echo {{nope}}
-- unknown-variable-in-assignment --
x := y + "1"
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- unknown-function --
a:
    echo {{nope()}}
-- builtin-arity --
a:
    echo {{uppercase()}}
-- builtin-arity-many --
a:
    echo {{replace("a", "b")}}
-- dependency-too-many-arguments --
a: (b "1")
b:
    echo
-- dependency-missing-arguments --
a: b
b x:
    echo {{x}}
-- dependency-variadic-ok --
a: (b "1" "2" "3")
b +xs:
    echo {{xs}}
-- unknown-setting --
set nonsense
a:
    echo
-- unknown-attribute --
[nonsense]
a:
    echo
-- attribute-too-many-arguments --
[private("x")]
a:
    echo
-- attribute-missing-argument --
[group]
a:
    echo
-- duplicate-recipe --
a:
    echo 1
a:
    echo 2
-- duplicate-recipe-allowed --
set allow-duplicate-recipes
a:
    echo 1
a:
    echo 2
-- duplicate-recipe-other-system --
[linux]
a:
    echo 1
[macos]
a:
    echo 2
-- duplicate-recipe-overlapping-system --
[unix]
a:
    echo 1
[linux]
a:
    echo 2
-- duplicate-variable --
x := "1"
x := "2"
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- duplicate-variable-allowed --
set allow-duplicate-variables
x := "1"
x := "2"
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- duplicate-alias --
alias b := a
alias b := a
a:
    echo
-- alias-shadows-recipe --
alias b := a
b:
    echo
a:
    echo
-- unknown-alias-target --
alias b := nope
a:
    echo
-- circular-dependency --
a: b
    echo
b: a
    echo
-- self-dependency --
a: a
    echo
-- circular-variable --
x := y
y := x
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- self-variable --
x := x
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- duplicate-setting --
set quiet
set quiet
a:
    echo
-- bool-setting-with-string --
set export := "yes"
a:
    echo
-- list-setting-with-string --
set shell := "bash"
a:
    echo
-- duplicate-parameter --
a x x:
    echo {{x}}
-- parameter-after-default --
a x="1" y:
    echo {{x}} {{y}}
-- parameter-after-variadic --
a +x y:
    echo {{x}} {{y}}
-- inconsistent-indentation --
a:
  echo 1
	echo 2
-- extra-indentation --
a:
  echo 1
    echo 2
-- continuation-may-indent --
a:
  echo 1 \
    2
-- shebang-may-indent --
a:
  #!/usr/bin/env bash
  if true; then
    echo 1
  fi
-- list-literal-needs-lists --
x := ["a"]
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- concatenation-needs-lists --
x := "1" ++ "2"
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- negation-needs-lists --
x := if !("a" == "b") { "1" } else { "2" }
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- logic-needs-lists --
x := "a" && "b"
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- lists-need-unstable --
set lists
a:
    echo
-- functions-need-unstable --
f(x) := x
a:
    echo {{f("1")}}
-- user-function-arity --
set unstable
f(x) := x
a:
    echo {{f()}}
-- user-function-parameter --
set unstable
f(x) := x + y
a:
    echo {{f("1")}}
-- mapped-dependency-needs-star --
set unstable
set lists
items := ["a"]
a: *(b items)
b x:
    echo {{x}}
-- missing-module --
mod foo
a:
    echo
-- optional-module --
mod? foo
a: foo::b
    echo
-- missing-import --
import "nothere.just"
a:
    echo
-- optional-import --
import? "nothere.just"
a:
    echo
-- unused-parameter --
a x:
    echo hi
-- exported-parameter-used-in-shell --
a $x:
    echo $x
-- unused-variable --
x := "1"
a:
    echo
-- private-variable-unused --
_x := "1"
a:
    echo
-- exported-variable --
export x := "1"
a:
    echo
-- positional-arguments --
set positional-arguments
a x:
    echo $1
-- deprecated-function --
a:
    echo {{env_var("HOME")}}
-- deprecated-setting --
set windows-powershell
a:
    echo
-- parameter-default-uses-earlier --
a x y=(x + "1"):
    echo {{y}}
-- interpolation-sees-parameter --
a target:
    echo {{target}} {{uppercase(target)}}
-- constants --
a:
    echo {{HEX}} {{BOLD + "x" + NORMAL}}
-- conditional-expression --
os_name := if os() == "linux" { "Linux" } else { "Other" }
a:
    echo {{os_name}}
-- subsequent-dependencies --
a: && b c
    echo a
b:
    echo b
c:
    echo c
-- quiet-recipe --
@a:
    echo quiet
-- format-string --
name := "world"
msg := f"hello {{name}}"
a:
    echo {{msg}}
-- format-string-unknown --
msg := f"hello {{name}}"
a:
    echo {{msg}}
-- attribute-arguments --
[confirm("sure?")]
[group: "ci"]
[script("bash")]
[env("A", "b")]
a:
    echo $A
-- export-param-default --
a $x="1":
    echo $x
-- recipe-named-like-keyword --
set:
    echo
export:
    echo
-- variable-named-like-keyword --
alias := "1"
a:
    echo {{alias}}
-- comment-only-recipe --
a:
    # just a comment
-- comment-inside-parentheses --
x := (
  "a" + # c1
  "b"
)
a:
    echo {{x}}
-- multi-line-parentheses --
x := (
  "a" +
  "b"
)
a:
    echo {{x}}

    echo

    echo
